label: EFFECT_INDIVIDUATION_2: Occupancy of the fixed role
definition: The designated effect is present at a standpoint exactly when the fixed role has a candidate output there, regardless of which producer originally produced it.
note: Analyst criterion for the same role and candidate profile in the three-world replacement comparison. The stipulated role may be multiply realized across worlds. Applicability to a given concrete target requires an independent bridge from role equivalence to the identity required by that target. See docs/notes/counterpossible-conservativity.md.
